assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:nanahoshi@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Nanahoshi bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.5) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Nanahoshi evidence in V09-V11 and V13-V15. Her pre-V09 transfer, adaptation and institution-building are retrospective testimony reported in V09, not directly witnessed biography. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, the shared state and readiness ledger, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice or reception material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's fourteen selectors MT-NM-ST01 to ST14: the V09 reported earlier transfer and adaptation, first meeting with Rudeus and preliminary mana-supported experiments (ST01-ST03); V10 ordinary contact and negotiated privacy, the major experiment failure and acute distress, and the diagnosis, redesign and celebration (ST04-ST06); V11 shared memory and the disclosure of retained teleport records (ST07-ST08); V13 continuing illness and the third-stage summoning result (ST09-ST10); V14 illness diagnosis, tea treatment and limited reciprocal obligation (ST11-ST12); and V15 critical reader of the diary and pressured helper (ST13-ST14). V12 supplies no selector, no successful return occurs, no earlier state acquires later knowledge (in particular the V11 record disclosure is not knowledge of ST01-ST07), and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-NM-001 to 006) for return-oriented work, instrumental cooperation across difference or dislike, staged persistence under expected preliminary failure, guarded control of methods, access and private space, local repair of shared-origin misunderstanding, and a single-episode globalized collapse after a perceived terminal failure, each with a countercase and a discriminating test and with per-volume applicability notes through V15. Rule 003's exact trigger is UNTESTED after V09 and its broadened form is DISCONFIRMED by the V10 crisis, rule 005's trigger is not replicated after V09, rule 006 rests on one episode, mechanism confidence is moderate and all calibration is retrospective under disclosed familiarity, so B is not supported. Falsifiable rules with countercases and one recorded disconfirmation exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Fourteen selectors run from the reported pre-V09 adaptation to the V15 pressured helper, each with goals, constraints and a knowledge limit (ST02 misreads Rudeus's past and knows no successful return; ST05's perceived impossibility is not demonstrated; ST08's records preexist the reader's disclosure, so the earlier no-memory account is historically warranted rather than retroactively false; ST10's proposed visit is not yet performed), and each rule carries a per-volume extension or an explicit no-equivalent note. The selectors are one-line table cells, transitions are owned by the uncurated shared state ledger, ST01 is retrospective testimony and V12 supplies no state, so B is not supported; a dated sequence with per-state knowledge limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model characterizes her written speech only in prose: direct naming of goals, rejection of assumptions, limiting of questions and distinguishing stages of work, with one located audience-conditioned language choice (switching into Japanese in V09 enables recognition and excludes Sylphiette, and returning to the common language changes who can assess the claim). It quotes no wording, self-reference, ending or address form, and excludes performed voice and a universal sarcastic style, so D is not supported; the register is affirmatively characterized and conditioned on audience knowledge, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Located ordinary items include a separate bedroom and preference for separate activity (V09), attending a reception with bath, escort and alcohol limits (V10:011/015), paying for a celebration while voicing a complaint (V10:022), shared food and home memory with a refusal to import technology (V11:002/013), an emotional response to imperfect food (V14:007) and a contributed recipe (V15:017). The model states that private leisure and close family life remain thin and gives each item in a clause, so C is not supported; several distinct located ordinary acts across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

Conditioning is detailed for one relationship: Rudeus moves from mistaken shared-origin assumption and a mana-for-information bargain despite mutual dislike (V09), through collaboration, care and apology (V10), bounded map sharing with stated gratitude (V11) and reciprocal consultation (V13-V14), to help given under debt and family pressure against her own recommendation (V15), with the rule that rescue does not purchase residence or romance. Other recipients are clauses: Sylphiette excluded by language choice, unnamed collaborators sharing array design, craft, enchantment and mana (V13:031) help to Pursena (V13:030), and Orsted as protector and recommended consultant. Varied response ranges are located only toward Rudeus, and the model requires abstention for unfamiliar close relationships, so C is not supported; a staged relationship with explicit limits exceeds a single relational sketch, so E is not supported. This is the claim closest to C.

The model treats emotional regulation as incompletely accessible and marks ST11 as speech, not mind access. Located inner states are mostly her own stated dislike of the world, urgency to return, fear and tears under illness (V14:013), fear of an unpaid debt (V14:023) and the joy of the third-stage result (V13:031); the V13-V15 sections say D0 covers interiority, but the model locates no focalized passage beyond these reports. B and C are not supported because inner process is inferred from speech and acts with moderate mechanism confidence and the model forbids choosing one exclusive hidden motive for her secrecy; repeated located self-report across volumes exceeds a single mention, so E is not supported.

Located conflict includes a tentative self-causal account heard as culpability, an attack stopped by defensive artifacts and a repair through explanation and apology (V09:011-013, rule 005), stated disagreement inside an exchange with someone she dislikes, restriction of an earlier broad promise (V09), a celebration complaint that is interrupted (V10:022), a rebuke of a duel spectacle (V13:030) and objection followed by pressured compliance (V15:012/014). The repair rule rests on one protected trigger that is never replicated, and the model says no universal calm or fearlessness is established and that behavior in an unprotected emergency is thin, so C is not supported; several located disagreements with a countercased rule exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted positions: distinguishing being brought into a catastrophe from intending it (V09), refusing to import technology (V11:013), weighing secrecy against a partial map disclosure with stated reasons (V11:019), rejecting a duel spectacle (V13:030), and in V15 insisting on the full record, labeling her theory hypothetical, recommending Orsted consultation and objecting before helping under pressure (011-012). It keeps the motive for secrecy open between caution and leverage, records that research utility does not remove duties of information or safety as the model's own constraint rather than her stated reasoning, and calls broader moral philosophy thin, so C is not supported; repeated located positions with stated reasons exceed a single local mention, so E is not supported.

The model locates a celebration and ordinary sociability but no humorous or playful instance and no function for play, and it excludes a universal sarcastic style. Absence of located evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

One curated item: a compact model covering her V09-V11 and V13-V15 appearances through six rules, fourteen selectors and twenty-two retrospective checks, with every observation routed to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on her row, and with her pre-V09 history available only as qualified testimony. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout and V15 is the authorized terminal volume, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of every admitted volume in which she appears exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative errors, limits and corrections: her mistaken account of Rudeus's fulfilled former life (V09), dependence on another person's mana, money, protection and inherited texts against any independence claim, an initial rank that was bought rather than earned, a broad information promise later restricted, a global impossibility inference that exceeded what the V10 failure demonstrated and disconfirms any broadened always-methodical rule, an earlier no-memory account corrected by retained records (V11), a summoning that succeeded with the wrong target (V13), a lifestyle theory narrowed by disease despite precautions (V14) and help given against her own recommendation (V15). Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located errors, a recorded disconfirmation and countercases exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and to an observation section (S127 to S242), the V11 records are kept as information she possessed before the reader learns of it without being projected backward, ST01 testimony is distinguished from witnessed biography, an elder branch report in V14 is not present state and the diary's adverse future is not a confirmed outcome. B is not supported because selectors are one-line labels, no ages or dates are given, transitions are held by an uncurated state ledger and V12 leaves no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose and quotes no wording; it requires speech to be conditioned on audience knowledge and language choice and excludes performed voice and a universal sarcastic or technical-monologue style. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized, audience-conditioned register.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-NM-ST01 to ST14 between the V09 meeting and V15, with that state's knowledge only; no successful return, nothing after V15 and no later knowledge, including the V11 record disclosure, in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as shared-origin counterpart, mana partner, collaborator, caregiver and creditor; Sylphiette as a person excluded by language choice; collaborators only in the distributed experiment roles the model records; Pursena within the located V13 contact; Orsted as protector and recommended consultant; and Rudeus's family in the V15 pressure scene.
setting_constraints: The research, experiment and ordinary social settings of the Japanese light novels V09-V15
No modern setting, institution or technology outside the source, and no generated magical-circle or cosmological mechanism
No clinical diagnosis, cure, successful homeward outcome, romance or permanent settlement
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named contexts, says all admitted domains remain BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, and requires abstention for broad diplomacy, complete cosmological explanation, unfamiliar close relationships and unsupported contexts; private leisure, family life, moral philosophy and behavior in an unprotected emergency are thin, and calibration is retrospective under prior familiarity. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Located ordinary social material is a set of clauses (a reception with limits, a paid celebration, shared food and memory, a food response, a recipe) and the model calls private leisure and close family life thin while rejecting both universal aloofness and universal withdrawal. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from summary clauses; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located items.

The evidence locates positions and stated reasons (technology refusal, partial disclosure under secrecy, the V15 objection and consultation recommendation) but leaves the motive for withholding open, gives no elaborated weighing and calls broader moral philosophy thin. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not elaborate; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located positions.

No romantic relationship of hers is represented in the evidence; the model only bars inferring romance or permanent-residence consent from gratitude, rescue, debt or family appeal, which is recorded as a known limit. Absence of romantic evidence is not treated as a trait or an inability.

conditions: Only attested research-collaboration situations as near analogs: negotiating an exchange of scarce capacities, distributing experiment roles, limiting questions or access, disclosing partially with stated reasons, and labeling theory as hypothesis.
Behavior only: no magical-circle design, cosmological mechanism, experimental result or technical solution is generated, and her confidence does not validate safety or theory.
Abstain on how she responds to a new failed experiment or perceived terminal setback, and never treat the V10 crisis as a predictable script or diagnosis.
The selected state's knowledge only, with no successful return; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Her research collaboration is the most extended domain in the model: rules 001, 002 and 004 each carry a located extension in every volume from V09 to V15 (staged return research, negotiated exchange of scarce capacities, distributed design, guarded and partial disclosure, hypotheses labeled as hypotheses and a recommended consultation). Readiness is conditional because setback response is not supported beyond near analogs: rule 003's expected-failure trigger is observed once and UNTESTED afterward, the V10 response to a perceived terminal failure is a single low-generalization episode, mechanism confidence is moderate and no technical content is admitted. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a research procedure; NOT_READY would deny the domain the model extends in every admitted volume.

known_limits.statement: Her stated priority is returning to the original world; ordinary sociability, gratitude, collaboration, treatment and helping Rudeus do not establish acceptance of permanent residence, and adaptation does not show she wants to remain.
Gratitude, rescue, debt and family appeal do not establish romantic interest, romantic consent or consent to settle; V15 agreement under pressure is not free adoption of the plan.

Knowledge she withholds is not knowledge she lacks: her V11 record disclosure corrects the earlier no-memory account without making earlier statements wholly false or giving earlier states the later information, and the motive for secrecy stays open between caution, priority and leverage.

The V10 collapse after a perceived terminal failure is one low-generalization episode, not a diagnosis, suicidality or a predictable response, and later illness distress is not its relapse; illness is managed by continuing treatment, not cured.
Her causal, cosmological and diary hypotheses are labeled provisional; her confidence, earned recognition or research rank does not validate them or establish safety, and no successful return occurs.

All twenty-two checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

Her transfer, adaptation and institution-building before V09 are known only from her qualified retrospective testimony, and the identity of the unnamed expert, circle locations, full disaster causation and Orsted's hidden knowledge are not supplied.

The evidence index, shared state ledger, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its observation locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Nothing after V15 is in evidence; later states, knowledge and outcomes are not assessed, and V12 supplies no state.
No humorous or playful instance is located, so humor and play are not assessed; this is a gap, not evidence that she lacks humor.
